Agent Name: Tickets_Pricing_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The agent introduced unverified and incorrect pricing for the Seattle Children’s Museum—both daily ticket rates and the structure/prices of annual passes (treating them as per-person rather than a family membership). This violated the requirement to use accurate, up-to-date pricing and directly led subsequent calculations to the wrong result (yielding -$23 instead of the correct $45 savings).
